column1: # NORMAN SEED REPLICATES -- the PUBLISHED arm (NQ02) at seeds 43, 44, 45, 46
# WHY. Every number reported on this benchmark so far is n=1 SEED. Pairing over the 5
# split-halves removes PANEL sampling noise, not model noise: the splits re-slice the same
# cells from the SAME trained checkpoint. The seed is what re-draws the trained model, so
# it is the unit of replication for any statistical claim
# (scripts/seed_split_test.py refuses to emit a p-value from one seed, which is the
# situation these runs exist to fix).
# WHAT IS VARIED: the seed, and nothing else. Every row is byte-identical to the published
# arm in configuration -- NQ02: Q02 base, 150 epochs, eta_min 3e-4, batch 2048, lr 1e-3 --
# so the spread across these four runs IS the seed variance, with no confound.
# WHAT EACH OUTCOME MEANS
#   a spread much SMALLER than the effects we have been reporting (0.02-0.06 pearson_delta)
#     -> the n=1 numbers were safe and the published margins stand;
#   a spread COMPARABLE to them
#     -> several reported margins are within seed noise and must be re-stated as such,
#        including the TxPert/Occam stratum reversal (F-comp6) and the mode ranking that
#        selected `decode_seq_mean` as the default.
# Either way it is the measurement that lets the campaign's margins be quoted honestly.
# ⚠️ seed 42 already exists -- these four COMPLETE the 5-seed design, they do not replace it.
